policy: Append new events; do not rewrite historical human decisions. An acceptance is effective only while its scenario content hash matches.

events.rationale: The named human accepts the complete listed scenario tranche after reviewing the project analysis and the disclosed deterministic per-instrument structural preflight.
events.human_decision_scope: Every scenario ID and exact content hash listed in this event.

ai_assistance.scope: Scenario authoring assistance, corpus analysis, and deterministic structural preflight for every listed instrument.
